captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional motel. Not a client project.

Guests pick dates on the homepage, tap Book Now, then type the dates again on the booking page and still don't see a price until step 3. The fix: dates and the nightly rate on the homepage, and a booking page that opens already filled in.

Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional motel's booking flow.

Before: dates chosen on the homepage are forgotten by the booking engine, guests enter them again, and the rate only appears after picking a room and extras. Six taps to see a price.

After: dates and the nightly rate sit on the homepage, and the booking page opens already filled in. Two taps to book.

Not a client project. Happy to look at yours: prycedigital.com/book
